# 1817. Finding the Users Active Minutes

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def findingUsersActiveMinutes(self, logs, k):
        """
        :type logs: List[List[int]]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        d = collections.defaultdict(set)
        for x, y in logs:
            d[x].add(y)
        ans = [0] * k
        for k, v in d.items():
            ans[len(v) - 1] += 1
        return ans
```
